# Summary statistics for meteorological, hydrological, and ctd data

*Sources:*
* Wind speed and direction: NOAA Buoy, Moku o Loʻe, Oʻahu, HI (Station MOKH1; 21.433°N, 157.790°W) 
* Precipitation: PacIOOS meteorological station, on Moku o Loʻe, Oʻahu, HI (Station HIMB; 21.433°N, 157.786°W)
* Stream discharge: USGS National Water Information System, Haʻikū Valley, Kāneʻohe, HI (Station 16275000; 21.409°N, 157.823°W; elevation 82.9 m)
* Pressure, Salinity, Temperature, and Current speed and direction: In-situ instrument package (21.43917°N, 157.80821°W)

## NOAA buoy data (wind speed and direction)
```{r}
# Helper function: circular mean for degrees
circular_mean_deg <- function(x_deg) {
  x <- x_deg[!is.na(x_deg)] * pi/180
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mu <- atan2(mean(sin(x)), mean(cos(x)))
  (mu * 180/pi) %% 360
}

# Helper function: circular sd for degrees
circular_sd_deg <- function(x_deg) {
  x <- x_deg[!is.na(x_deg)] * pi/180
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  R <- sqrt(mean(cos(x))^2 + mean(sin(x))^2)
  sqrt(-2 * log(R)) * 180/pi
}

# Helper: minimum circular difference (deg)
circular_diff_deg <- function(a, b) {
  raw_diff <- abs(a - b)
  pmin(raw_diff, 360 - raw_diff)
}

# Helper: first recovery day for scalar variable using daily mean within pre mean ± 1 SD
first_recovery_day_scalar <- function(df_daily, value_col,
                                      pre_start, pre_end, storm_end, post_end) {
  df_pre <- df_daily %>% filter(date >= pre_start, date <= pre_end)
  if (nrow(df_pre) == 0) {
    return(tibble(recovery_day = NA_Date_, days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
                  status = "No pre-storm baseline days"))
  }

  xpre <- df_pre[[value_col]]
  pre_mean <- mean(xpre, na.rm = TRUE)
  pre_sd   <- sd(xpre, na.rm = TRUE)

  lower <- pre_mean - pre_sd
  upper <- pre_mean + pre_sd

  df_post <- df_daily %>%
    filter(date > storm_end, date <= post_end) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(ok = .data[[value_col]] >= lower & .data[[value_col]] <= upper)

  hit <- df_post %>% filter(ok) %>% slice(1)

  if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
    return(tibble(recovery_day = NA_Date_, days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
                  status = "Did not return within observation window"))
  }

  tibble(
    recovery_day = hit$date,
    days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date - storm_end),
    status = "Recovered"
  )
}

# Helper: first recovery day for direction using daily circular mean within circular mean ± circular SD
first_recovery_day_direction <- function(df_daily, dir_col,
                                         pre_start, pre_end, storm_end, post_end) {
  df_pre <- df_daily %>% filter(date >= pre_start, date <= pre_end)
  if (nrow(df_pre) == 0) {
    return(tibble(recovery_day = NA_Date_, days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
                  status = "No pre-storm baseline days"))
  }

  mu <- circular_mean_deg(df_pre[[dir_col]])
  sd <- circular_sd_deg(df_pre[[dir_col]])

  df_post <- df_daily %>%
    filter(date > storm_end, date <= post_end) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(ok = circular_diff_deg(.data[[dir_col]], mu) <= sd)

  hit <- df_post %>% filter(ok) %>% slice(1)

  if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
    return(tibble(recovery_day = NA_Date_, days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
                  status = "Did not return within observation window"))
  }

  tibble(
    recovery_day = hit$date,
    days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date - storm_end),
    status = "Recovered"
  )
}

# Main function (now returns both stats + recovery)
summarize_buoy_wind <- function(file_path,
                               buoy_tz = "UTC",
                               phase_tz = "Pacific/Honolulu",
                               circular_dir = TRUE,
                               pre_start = as.Date("2014-07-06"),
                               pre_end   = as.Date("2014-07-19"),
                               storm_start = as.Date("2014-07-20"),
                               storm_end   = as.Date("2014-07-21"),
                               post_start  = as.Date("2014-07-22"),
                               post_end    = as.Date("2014-08-12")) {

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Drop the metadata + units rows (e.g., "#yr", "deg", "m/s")
  df <- df %>% filter(str_detect(`#YY`, "^\\d{4}$"))

  df2 <- df %>%
    transmute(
      year = as.integer(`#YY`),
      mo   = as.integer(MM),
      dy   = as.integer(DD),
      hr   = as.integer(hh),
      mn   = as.integer(mm),
      wind_direction = as.numeric(WDI),
      wind_speed     = as.numeric(`R WSP`)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # NDBC missing codes (common): 999 for direction, 99 for speed
      wind_speed     = if_else(!is.na(wind_speed)     & wind_speed     >=  99, NA_real_, wind_speed),
      wind_direction = if_else(!is.na(wind_direction) & wind_direction >= 999, NA_real_, wind_direction),

      datetime_utc = make_datetime(year, mo, dy, hr, mn, tz = buoy_tz),
      date_local   = as.Date(with_tz(datetime_utc, tzone = phase_tz)),

      phase = case_when(
        date_local >= pre_start   & date_local <= pre_end   ~ "pre-storm",
        date_local >= storm_start & date_local <= storm_end ~ "storm",
        date_local >= post_start  & date_local <= post_end  ~ "post-storm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  # Keep a phase-filtered version for summary stats
  df_phase <- df2 %>% filter(!is.na(phase))

  if (nrow(df_phase) == 0) {
    stop("No rows fell within storm windows after parsing/filtering.")
  }

  # --- summarize wind speed (scalar per phase) ---
  speed_sum <- df_phase %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable = "wind_speed",
      mean = if (all(is.na(wind_speed))) NA_real_ else mean(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = if (sum(!is.na(wind_speed)) < 2) NA_real_ else sd(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
      min  = if (all(is.na(wind_speed))) NA_real_ else min(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = if (all(is.na(wind_speed))) NA_real_ else max(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- summarize wind direction (circular stats by default) ---
  dir_sum <- df_phase %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable = "wind_direction",
      mean = if (circular_dir) circular_mean_deg(wind_direction)
      else if (all(is.na(wind_direction))) NA_real_ else mean(wind_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = if (circular_dir) circular_sd_deg(wind_direction)
      else if (sum(!is.na(wind_direction)) < 2) NA_real_ else sd(wind_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
      min  = if (all(is.na(wind_direction))) NA_real_ else min(wind_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = if (all(is.na(wind_direction))) NA_real_ else max(wind_direction, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  summary_long <- bind_rows(speed_sum, dir_sum) %>%
    mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("pre-storm", "storm", "post-storm"))) %>%
    arrange(variable, phase)

  summary_wide <- summary_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, min, max),
      names_glue = "{phase}_{.value}"
    ) %>%
    select(
      variable,
      `pre-storm_mean`, `pre-storm_sd`, `pre-storm_min`, `pre-storm_max`,
      `storm_mean`,     `storm_sd`,     `storm_min`,     `storm_max`,
      `post-storm_mean`,`post-storm_sd`,`post-storm_min`,`post-storm_max`
    )

  # -----------------------
  # Recovery time (daily series)
  # -----------------------
  wind_speed_daily <- df2 %>%
    group_by(date = date_local) %>%
    summarize(wind_speed = mean(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  wind_dir_daily <- df2 %>%
    group_by(date = date_local) %>%
    summarize(wind_direction = circular_mean_deg(wind_direction), .groups = "drop")

  rec_speed <- first_recovery_day_scalar(
    wind_speed_daily, value_col = "wind_speed",
    pre_start = pre_start, pre_end = pre_end, storm_end = storm_end, post_end = post_end
  ) %>%
    mutate(variable = "wind_speed")

  rec_dir <- first_recovery_day_direction(
    wind_dir_daily, dir_col = "wind_direction",
    pre_start = pre_start, pre_end = pre_end, storm_end = storm_end, post_end = post_end
  ) %>%
    mutate(variable = "wind_direction")

  recovery_tbl <- bind_rows(rec_speed, rec_dir) %>%
    select(variable, recovery_day, days_to_recovery, status)

  # Return both objects (print either one as needed)
  list(
    stats = summary_wide,
    recovery = recovery_tbl
  )
}

# --- Run function ---
buoy_out <- summarize_buoy_wind(file.path(input_path_1, "noaa_buoy_mokh1_wind.csv"))

buoy_out$stats
buoy_out$recovery
```

## HIMB rain gauge
```{r}
summarize_precipitation_daily <- function(file_path,
                                         data_tz = "Pacific/Honolulu",
                                         pre_start   = as.Date("2014-07-06"),
                                         pre_end     = as.Date("2014-07-19"),
                                         storm_start = as.Date("2014-07-20"),
                                         storm_end   = as.Date("2014-07-21"),
                                         post_start  = as.Date("2014-07-22"),
                                         post_end    = as.Date("2014-08-12")) {

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  df_daily_all <- df %>%
    mutate(
      # Safely parse datetime (silences unit-row warning)
      datetime = suppressWarnings(ymd_hms(time, tz = data_tz)),
      date = as.Date(datetime),

      # Force rainfall to numeric (handles unit row like "mm")
      rainfall_mm = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(rainfall_amount))),

      # Convert mm → cm
      rainfall_cm = rainfall_mm / 10
    ) %>%
    # Drop rows that failed parsing (units/header rows)
    filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(rainfall_cm)) %>%
    # ---- DAILY TOTALS ----
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarize(
      daily_precip_cm = sum(rainfall_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Recovery (baseline daily totals) ----
  # baseline = pre-storm daily totals; recovery day = first post-storm day <= max(pre-storm daily)
  pre_daily <- df_daily_all %>% filter(date >= pre_start, date <= pre_end)

  if (nrow(pre_daily) == 0) {
    recovery_tbl <- tibble(
      variable = "precipitation_cmpd",
      recovery_day = NA_Date_,
      days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
      status = "No pre-storm baseline days"
    )
  } else {
    pre_max <- max(pre_daily$daily_precip_cm, na.rm = TRUE)

    post_daily <- df_daily_all %>%
      filter(date > storm_end, date <= post_end) %>%
      arrange(date) %>%
      mutate(ok = daily_precip_cm <= pre_max)

    hit <- post_daily %>% filter(ok) %>% slice(1)

    recovery_tbl <- if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
      tibble(
        variable = "precipitation_cmpd",
        recovery_day = NA_Date_,
        days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
        status = "Did not return within observation window"
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        variable = "precipitation_cmpd",
        recovery_day = hit$date,
        days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date - storm_end),
        status = "Recovered"
      )
    }
  }

  # ---- Phase assignment for summary stats ----
  df_daily_phase <- df_daily_all %>%
    mutate(
      phase = case_when(
        date >= pre_start   & date <= pre_end   ~ "pre-storm",
        date >= storm_start & date <= storm_end ~ "storm",
        date >= post_start  & date <= post_end  ~ "post-storm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(phase))

  if (nrow(df_daily_phase) == 0) {
    stop("No daily precipitation values fall within storm windows.")
  }

  summary_long <- df_daily_phase %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable = "precipitation_cmpd",
      mean = mean(daily_precip_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = if (n() < 2) NA_real_ else sd(daily_precip_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
      min  = min(daily_precip_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = max(daily_precip_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("pre-storm","storm","post-storm")))

  summary_wide <- summary_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, min, max),
      names_glue = "{phase}_{.value}"
    ) %>%
    select(
      variable,
      `pre-storm_mean`, `pre-storm_sd`, `pre-storm_min`, `pre-storm_max`,
      `storm_mean`,     `storm_sd`,     `storm_min`,     `storm_max`,
      `post-storm_mean`,`post-storm_sd`,`post-storm_min`,`post-storm_max`
    )

  # Return both
  list(
    stats = summary_wide,
    recovery = recovery_tbl
  )
}

# --- Run function ---
rain_out <- summarize_precipitation_daily(
  file.path(input_path_1, "pacioos_himb_rain_gauge.csv")
)

rain_out$stats
rain_out$recovery
```

## USGS stream gauge
```{r}
summarize_stream_daily <- function(file_path,
                                  data_tz = "Pacific/Honolulu",
                                  pre_start   = as.Date("2014-07-06"),
                                  pre_end     = as.Date("2014-07-19"),
                                  storm_start = as.Date("2014-07-20"),
                                  storm_end   = as.Date("2014-07-21"),
                                  post_start  = as.Date("2014-07-22"),
                                  post_end    = as.Date("2014-08-12")) {

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # ---- Build DAILY SERIES (all dates; do not filter to phases yet) ----
  df_daily_all <- df %>%
    # Keep only real USGS data rows
    filter(!is.na(agency), toupper(agency) == "USGS") %>%
    mutate(
      # Parse discharge
      discharge_cfs = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(Discharge))),

      # Convert cfs -> m^3/s
      discharge_m3s = discharge_cfs * 0.0283168466,

      # Build datetime from separate date + time columns
      datetime = suppressWarnings(mdy_hm(paste(date, time), tz = data_tz)),
      date_only = as.Date(datetime)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(date_only), !is.na(discharge_m3s)) %>%
    group_by(date_only) %>%
    summarize(
      daily_mean_discharge_m3s = mean(discharge_m3s, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ---- Recovery (baseline daily totals analog) ----
  pre_daily <- df_daily_all %>% filter(date_only >= pre_start, date_only <= pre_end)

  if (nrow(pre_daily) == 0) {
    recovery_tbl <- tibble(
      variable = "stream_discharge_m3s",
      recovery_day = NA_Date_,
      days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
      status = "No pre-storm baseline days"
    )
  } else {
    pre_max <- max(pre_daily$daily_mean_discharge_m3s, na.rm = TRUE)

    post_daily <- df_daily_all %>%
      filter(date_only > storm_end, date_only <= post_end) %>%
      arrange(date_only) %>%
      mutate(ok = daily_mean_discharge_m3s <= pre_max)

    hit <- post_daily %>% filter(ok) %>% slice(1)

    recovery_tbl <- if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
      tibble(
        variable = "stream_discharge_m3s",
        recovery_day = NA_Date_,
        days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
        status = "Did not return within observation window"
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        variable = "stream_discharge_m3s",
        recovery_day = hit$date_only,
        days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date_only - storm_end),
        status = "Recovered"
      )
    }
  }

  # ---- Phase assignment for summary stats ----
  df_daily_phase <- df_daily_all %>%
    mutate(
      phase = case_when(
        date_only >= pre_start   & date_only <= pre_end   ~ "pre-storm",
        date_only >= storm_start & date_only <= storm_end ~ "storm",
        date_only >= post_start  & date_only <= post_end  ~ "post-storm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(phase))

  if (nrow(df_daily_phase) == 0) {
    stop("No daily discharge values fall within storm windows.")
  }

  summary_long <- df_daily_phase %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable = "stream_discharge_m3s",
      mean = mean(daily_mean_discharge_m3s, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = if (n() < 2) NA_real_ else sd(daily_mean_discharge_m3s, na.rm = TRUE),
      min  = min(daily_mean_discharge_m3s, na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = max(daily_mean_discharge_m3s, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("pre-storm","storm","post-storm")))

  summary_wide <- summary_long %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, min, max),
      names_glue = "{phase}_{.value}"
    ) %>%
    select(
      variable,
      `pre-storm_mean`, `pre-storm_sd`, `pre-storm_min`, `pre-storm_max`,
      `storm_mean`,     `storm_sd`,     `storm_min`,     `storm_max`,
      `post-storm_mean`,`post-storm_sd`,`post-storm_min`,`post-storm_max`
    )

  list(
    stats = summary_wide,
    recovery = recovery_tbl
  )
}

# --- Run function ---
stream_out <- summarize_stream_daily(
  file.path(input_path_1, "usgs_stream_gauge.csv")
)
```

## CTD data (salinity, temperature, pressure)
```{r}
summarize_ctd_file <- function(file_path,
                               tz = "Pacific/Honolulu",
                               pre_start   = as.Date("2014-07-06"),
                               pre_end     = as.Date("2014-07-19"),
                               storm_start = as.Date("2014-07-20"),
                               storm_end   = as.Date("2014-07-21"),
                               post_start  = as.Date("2014-07-22"),
                               post_end    = as.Date("2014-08-12")) {

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # value column = everything except datetime
  value_col <- setdiff(names(df), "datetime")
  if (length(value_col) != 1) {
    stop("File must contain exactly one value column besides 'datetime'")
  }
  value_col <- value_col[[1]]

  variable_name <- basename(file_path) |>
    str_remove("^extracted_") |>
    str_remove("^ctd_extracted_") |>
    str_remove("\\.csv$")

  df2 <- df |>
    mutate(
      # Robust parse to POSIXct, then Date
      datetime_parsed = case_when(
        inherits(datetime, "POSIXt") ~ as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = tz),
        TRUE ~ {
          dt_chr <- str_squish(str_replace_all(as.character(datetime), "\u00A0", " "))
          # handle common formats: mdy HMS p, mdy HM p, mdy HMS, mdy HM, ymd HMS, ymd HM
          suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
            dt_chr,
            orders = c("mdy HMS p", "mdy HM p", "mdy HMS", "mdy HM",
                       "ymd HMS", "ymd HM"),
            tz = tz
          ))
        }
      ),
      date = as.Date(datetime_parsed),

      phase = case_when(
        date >= pre_start   & date <= pre_end   ~ "pre-storm",
        date >= storm_start & date <= storm_end ~ "storm",
        date >= post_start  & date <= post_end  ~ "post-storm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  if (all(is.na(df2$date))) {
    stop("All dates are NA after parsing. Example datetime values:\n",
         paste(head(as.character(df$datetime), 5), collapse = "\n"))
  }

  # -------------------------
  # Phase summary stats (as you had)
  # -------------------------
  df_summary_long <- df2 |>
    filter(!is.na(phase)) |>
    group_by(variable = variable_name, phase) |>
    summarize(
      n    = sum(!is.na(.data[[value_col]])),
      mean = if (n > 0) mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      sd   = if (n > 1) sd(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      min  = if (n > 0) min(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      max  = if (n > 0) max(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("pre-storm", "storm", "post-storm"))) |>
    arrange(variable, phase)

  if (nrow(df_summary_long) == 0) {
    rng <- range(df2$date, na.rm = TRUE)
    stop(
      "No rows fell within the specified storm windows.\n",
      "Observed date range in this file: ", rng[1], " to ", rng[2], "\n",
      "Check that this instrument file actually covers 2014-07-05 to 2014-08-12."
    )
  }

  df_summary_wide <- df_summary_long |>
    select(-n) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, min, max),
      names_glue = "{phase}_{.value}"
    ) |>
    select(
      variable,
      `pre-storm_mean`, `pre-storm_sd`, `pre-storm_min`, `pre-storm_max`,
      `storm_mean`,     `storm_sd`,     `storm_min`,     `storm_max`,
      `post-storm_mean`,`post-storm_sd`,`post-storm_min`,`post-storm_max`
    )

  # -------------------------
  # Recovery (daily mean returns to pre mean ± 1 SD)
  # -------------------------
  df_daily <- df2 |>
    filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(.data[[value_col]])) |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarize(daily_mean = mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  pre_daily <- df_daily |>
    filter(date >= pre_start, date <= pre_end)

  recovery_tbl <- if (nrow(pre_daily) == 0) {
    tibble(
      variable = variable_name,
      recovery_day = NA_Date_,
      days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
      status = "No pre-storm baseline days"
    )
  } else {
    pre_mu <- mean(pre_daily$daily_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    pre_sd <- sd(pre_daily$daily_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    lower <- pre_mu - pre_sd
    upper <- pre_mu + pre_sd

    post_daily <- df_daily |>
      filter(date > storm_end, date <= post_end) |>
      arrange(date) |>
      mutate(ok = daily_mean >= lower & daily_mean <= upper)

    hit <- post_daily |>
      filter(ok) |>
      slice(1)

    if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
      tibble(
        variable = variable_name,
        recovery_day = NA_Date_,
        days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
        status = "Did not return within observation window"
      )
    } else {
      tibble(
        variable = variable_name,
        recovery_day = hit$date,
        days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date - storm_end),
        status = "Recovered"
      )
    }
  }

  list(
    stats = df_summary_wide,
    recovery = recovery_tbl
  )
}

ctd_out <- list(

)
```

## CTD data (current speed and direction)
```{r}
# ---- circular helpers ----
circular_mean_deg <- function(x_deg) {
  x <- x_deg[!is.na(x_deg)] * pi/180
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mu <- atan2(mean(sin(x)), mean(cos(x)))
  (mu * 180/pi) %% 360
}

circular_sd_deg <- function(x_deg) {
  x <- x_deg[!is.na(x_deg)] * pi/180
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  R <- sqrt(mean(cos(x))^2 + mean(sin(x))^2)
  sqrt(-2 * log(R)) * 180/pi
}

circular_diff_deg <- function(a, b) {
  raw_diff <- abs(a - b)
  pmin(raw_diff, 360 - raw_diff)
}

summarize_ctd_current <- function(file_path,
                                  tz = "Pacific/Honolulu",
                                  pre_start   = as.Date("2014-07-06"),
                                  pre_end     = as.Date("2014-07-19"),
                                  storm_start = as.Date("2014-07-20"),
                                  storm_end   = as.Date("2014-07-21"),
                                  post_start  = as.Date("2014-07-22"),
                                  post_end    = as.Date("2014-08-12")) {

  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (!("datetime" %in% names(df))) {
    stop("No 'datetime' column found. Columns are: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
  }

  df2 <- df %>%
    mutate(
      date = case_when(
        inherits(datetime, "POSIXt") ~ as.Date(datetime),
        TRUE ~ {
          dt_chr <- str_squish(str_replace_all(as.character(datetime), "\u00A0", " "))

          # Try common datetime formats (including 2-digit year + HM)
          dt <- suppressWarnings(mdy_hm(dt_chr, tz = tz))                         # 6/10/14 18:25
          dt <- coalesce(dt, suppressWarnings(mdy_hms(dt_chr, tz = tz)))          # 6/10/2014 18:25:30
          dt <- coalesce(dt, suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
            dt_chr, orders = c("mdy HMS p","mdy HM p"), tz = tz
          )))                                                                      # 6/11/2014 9:52:30 AM
          dt <- coalesce(dt, suppressWarnings(ymd_hms(dt_chr, tz = tz)))          # 2014-06-10 11:34:25
          dt <- coalesce(dt, suppressWarnings(ymd_hm(dt_chr, tz = tz)))           # 2014-06-10 11:34

          as.Date(dt)
        }
      ),
      phase = case_when(
        date >= pre_start   & date <= pre_end   ~ "pre-storm",
        date >= storm_start & date <= storm_end ~ "storm",
        date >= post_start  & date <= post_end  ~ "post-storm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  if (all(is.na(df2$date))) {
    stop("All dates are NA after parsing. Example datetime values:\n",
         paste(head(as.character(df$datetime), 5), collapse = "\n"))
  }

  df_phase <- df2 %>% filter(!is.na(phase))

  if (nrow(df_phase) == 0) {
    rng <- range(df2$date, na.rm = TRUE)
    stop(
      "No CTD current data fall within storm windows after parsing.\n",
      "Observed date range in this file: ", rng[1], " to ", rng[2]
    )
  }

  # -------------------------
  # Phase summary stats
  # -------------------------
  speed_sum <- df_phase %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable = "current_speed_ms",
      mean = mean(current_speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = if (sum(!is.na(current_speed_ms)) < 2) NA_real_ else sd(current_speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      min  = min(current_speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = max(current_speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  dir_sum <- df_phase %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable = "current_direction_deg",
      mean = circular_mean_deg(current_direction_deg),
      sd   = circular_sd_deg(current_direction_deg),
      min  = min(current_direction_deg, na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = max(current_direction_deg, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  stats_wide <- bind_rows(speed_sum, dir_sum) %>%
    mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("pre-storm","storm","post-storm"))) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = phase,
      values_from = c(mean, sd, min, max),
      names_glue = "{phase}_{.value}"
    ) %>%
    select(
      variable,
      `pre-storm_mean`, `pre-storm_sd`, `pre-storm_min`, `pre-storm_max`,
      `storm_mean`,     `storm_sd`,     `storm_min`,     `storm_max`,
      `post-storm_mean`,`post-storm_sd`,`post-storm_min`,`post-storm_max`
    )

  # -------------------------
  # Recovery (DAILY series)
  # -------------------------
  # Daily mean speed
  speed_daily <- df2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(current_speed_ms)) %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarize(daily_speed = mean(current_speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Daily circular mean direction
  dir_daily <- df2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(current_direction_deg)) %>%
    group_by(date) %>%
    summarize(daily_dir = circular_mean_deg(current_direction_deg), .groups = "drop")

  # Speed recovery: within pre mean ± 1 SD
  pre_speed <- speed_daily %>% filter(date >= pre_start, date <= pre_end)

  rec_speed <- if (nrow(pre_speed) == 0) {
    tibble(variable = "current_speed_ms",
           recovery_day = NA_Date_,
           days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
           status = "No pre-storm baseline days")
  } else {
    mu <- mean(pre_speed$daily_speed, na.rm = TRUE)
    s  <- sd(pre_speed$daily_speed, na.rm = TRUE)
    lower <- mu - s
    upper <- mu + s

    hit <- speed_daily %>%
      filter(date > storm_end, date <= post_end) %>%
      arrange(date) %>%
      mutate(ok = daily_speed >= lower & daily_speed <= upper) %>%
      filter(ok) %>%
      slice(1)

    if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
      tibble(variable = "current_speed_ms",
             recovery_day = NA_Date_,
             days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
             status = "Did not return within observation window")
    } else {
      tibble(variable = "current_speed_ms",
             recovery_day = hit$date,
             days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date - storm_end),
             status = "Recovered")
    }
  }

  # Direction recovery: within circular mean ± circular SD (minimum angular difference)
  pre_dir <- dir_daily %>% filter(date >= pre_start, date <= pre_end)

  rec_dir <- if (nrow(pre_dir) == 0) {
    tibble(variable = "current_direction_deg",
           recovery_day = NA_Date_,
           days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
           status = "No pre-storm baseline days")
  } else {
    mu <- circular_mean_deg(pre_dir$daily_dir)
    s  <- circular_sd_deg(pre_dir$daily_dir)

    hit <- dir_daily %>%
      filter(date > storm_end, date <= post_end) %>%
      arrange(date) %>%
      mutate(ok = circular_diff_deg(daily_dir, mu) <= s) %>%
      filter(ok) %>%
      slice(1)

    if (nrow(hit) == 0) {
      tibble(variable = "current_direction_deg",
             recovery_day = NA_Date_,
             days_to_recovery = NA_integer_,
             status = "Did not return within observation window")
    } else {
      tibble(variable = "current_direction_deg",
             recovery_day = hit$date,
             days_to_recovery = as.integer(hit$date - storm_end),
             status = "Recovered")
    }
  }

  recovery_tbl <- bind_rows(rec_speed, rec_dir)

  list(
    stats = stats_wide,
    recovery = recovery_tbl
  )
}

# --- Run function ---
ctd_current_out <- summarize_ctd_current(file.path(input_path_2, "ctd_extracted_current.csv"))
ctd_current_out$stats
ctd_current_out$recovery
```

# Calculate absolute and fold-changes
```{r}
# Circular difference helper
circular_diff_deg <- function(a, b) {
  raw_diff <- abs(a - b)
  pmin(raw_diff, 360 - raw_diff)
}

# helper to format numbers with per-row digits (character output)
fmt_mean_sd_vec <- function(mean_vec, sd_vec, digits_vec) {
  mapply(
    function(m, s, d) {
      if (is.na(m)) return(NA_character_)
      m_fmt <- sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), m)
      s_fmt <- if (is.na(s)) "NA" else sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), s)
      paste0(m_fmt, " ± ", s_fmt)
    },
    mean_vec, sd_vec, digits_vec,
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
}

fmt_num_vec <- function(x, digits_vec) {
  mapply(
    function(val, d) if (is.na(val)) NA_character_ else sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f"), val),
    x, digits_vec,
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
}

(all_stats_final <- all_stats %>%
  mutate(
    digits = purrr::map_int(variable, ~{
      d <- sig_figs[[.x]]
      if (is.null(d)) 2L else as.integer(d)
    }),
    is_direction = stringr::str_detect(variable, "direction"),

    # full precision differences first
    delta_pre_storm      = storm_mean - `pre-storm_mean`,
    delta_storm_post     = `post-storm_mean` - storm_mean,
    fold_pre_storm       = if_else(is_direction, NA_real_, storm_mean / `pre-storm_mean`),
    fold_storm_post      = if_else(is_direction, NA_real_, `post-storm_mean` / storm_mean),
    circ_diff_pre_storm  = if_else(is_direction, circular_diff_deg(storm_mean, `pre-storm_mean`), NA_real_),
    circ_diff_storm_post = if_else(is_direction, circular_diff_deg(`post-storm_mean`, storm_mean), NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # display columns
    pre   = fmt_mean_sd_vec(`pre-storm_mean`, `pre-storm_sd`, digits),
    storm = fmt_mean_sd_vec(storm_mean,       storm_sd,       digits),
    post  = fmt_mean_sd_vec(`post-storm_mean`,`post-storm_sd`,digits),

    # round numerics (stored)
    delta_pre_storm  = round(delta_pre_storm, digits),
    delta_storm_post = round(delta_storm_post, digits),
    fold_pre_storm   = if_else(is.na(fold_pre_storm), NA_real_, round(fold_pre_storm, 2)),
    fold_storm_post  = if_else(is.na(fold_storm_post), NA_real_, round(fold_storm_post, 2)),
    circ_diff_pre_storm  = if_else(is.na(circ_diff_pre_storm), NA_real_, round(circ_diff_pre_storm, 0)),
    circ_diff_storm_post = if_else(is.na(circ_diff_storm_post), NA_real_, round(circ_diff_storm_post, 0)),

    # NEW: formatted (character) versions that *display* with correct decimals
    delta_pre_storm_fmt  = fmt_num_vec(delta_pre_storm, digits),
    delta_storm_post_fmt = fmt_num_vec(delta_storm_post, digits),
    fold_pre_storm_fmt   = if_else(is.na(fold_pre_storm), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", fold_pre_storm)),
    fold_storm_post_fmt  = if_else(is.na(fold_storm_post), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", fold_storm_post))
  ) %>%
  select(
    variable,
    pre, storm, post,
    delta_pre_storm_fmt, fold_pre_storm_fmt,
    delta_storm_post_fmt, fold_storm_post_fmt,
    circ_diff_pre_storm, circ_diff_storm_post
  )
)
```

```{r}
# ---------- 1) NOAA verified water-level reader ------------------------------
# Copied verbatim from 01_tidal_dynamics.rmd, section 2a, so this chunk is
# self-contained. If you ever update one, update both for consistency.
parse_noaa_obs <- function(filepath) {
  raw <- read_csv(filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)

  message(sprintf("  %s — %d cols (%d rows): %s",
                  basename(filepath), ncol(raw), nrow(raw),
                  paste(names(raw), collapse = ", ")))

  # Standardise column names via partial match
  cnames <- tolower(names(raw))
  date_col     <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "^date")][1]
  time_col     <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "time")][1]
  pred_col     <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "predict")][1]
  verified_col <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "verif")][1]

  raw %>%
    rename(date_val   = !!date_col,
           time_val   = !!time_col,
           pred_m     = !!pred_col,
           verified_m = !!verified_col) %>%
    mutate(
      date_clean = as.Date(date_val),
      time_secs  = as.numeric(hms::as_hms(time_val)),
      datetime   = as.POSIXct(as.numeric(as.POSIXct(date_clean,
                                                    tz = "Pacific/Honolulu")) +
                                time_secs,
                              origin = "1970-01-01",
                              tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"),
      pred_m     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pred_m)),
      verified_m = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(verified_m))
    ) %>%
    select(datetime, pred_m, verified_m) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime), !is.na(verified_m))
}

# ---------- 2) Load and pool verified water levels ---------------------------
noaa_obs <- bind_rows(
  parse_noaa_obs(file.path(input_path_1, "tides/noaa_mokh1_tides_june.csv")),
  parse_noaa_obs(file.path(input_path_1, "tides/noaa_mokh1_tides_july.csv")),
  parse_noaa_obs(file.path(input_path_1, "tides/noaa_mokh1_tides_august.csv"))
) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  distinct()

stopifnot(nrow(noaa_obs) > 0)
message(sprintf("NOAA verified: %d rows (%s to %s)",
                nrow(noaa_obs),
                format(min(noaa_obs$datetime), "%Y-%m-%d"),
                format(max(noaa_obs$datetime), "%Y-%m-%d")))

# ---------- 3) Tidal extrema detector ----------------------------------------
# Copied verbatim from 01_tidal_dynamics.rmd, section 2b.
EXTREMA_HALF_WINDOW_MIN <- 220L

detect_extrema <- function(obs_df, half_window_min = EXTREMA_HALF_WINDOW_MIN) {
  hw <- dminutes(half_window_min)

  candidates <- obs_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_high = map_lgl(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
        win <- obs_df %>%
          filter(datetime >= datetime[i] - hw,
                 datetime <= datetime[i] + hw)
        verified_m[i] == max(win$verified_m, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      is_low = map_lgl(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
        win <- obs_df %>%
          filter(datetime >= datetime[i] - hw,
                 datetime <= datetime[i] + hw)
        verified_m[i] == min(win$verified_m, na.rm = TRUE)
      })
    ) %>%
    filter(is_high | is_low) %>%
    mutate(tide_type = case_when(
      is_high & !is_low ~ "H",
      is_low & !is_high ~ "L",
      TRUE              ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(tide_type))

  candidates %>%
    arrange(datetime) %>%
    mutate(type_run = cumsum(tide_type != lag(tide_type, default = ""))) %>%
    group_by(type_run) %>%
    slice(
      if (first(tide_type) == "H") which.max(verified_m)
      else which.min(verified_m)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(datetime, verified_m, pred_m, tide_type) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

message("Detecting tidal extrema from verified water levels (this may take ~30 s)...")
tides_noaa <- detect_extrema(noaa_obs)
message(sprintf("Detected %d tidal extrema from verified signal",
                nrow(tides_noaa)))

# ---------- 4) Shape into tides_tbl for low_tide_change_ctd() ----------------
tides_tbl <- tides_noaa %>%
  transmute(
    tide_datetime = datetime,
    tide_date     = as.Date(datetime),
    verified_m,
    pred_m,
    hilo          = tide_type
  )

# Sanity check: should see mostly (2, 2) for mixed semi-diurnal
tides_tbl %>%
  count(tide_date, hilo) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = hilo, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  count(H, L)

# ---------- 5) CTD reader ----------------------------------------------------
# Unchanged from your original
read_ctd <- function(ctd_csv_path, tz = "Pacific/Honolulu") {
  df <- read_csv(ctd_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  value_col <- setdiff(names(df), "datetime")
  if (length(value_col) != 1) stop("CTD file must have 'datetime' + exactly one value column.")
  df %>%
    mutate(
      dt_chr = str_squish(str_replace_all(as.character(datetime), "\u00A0", " ")),
      datetime = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
        dt_chr,
        orders = c("mdy HMS p","mdy HM p","mdy HMS","mdy HM","ymd HMS","ymd HM"),
        tz = tz
      )),
      value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[value_col]]))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime), !is.na(value)) %>%
    select(datetime, value)
}

# ---------- 6) Matched-low-tide function -------------------------------------
# Changes from original:
#   (a) slice_min on `verified_m` (was `pred_ft`)
#   (b) storm_end default = 2014-07-23 (4-day standardized window: 20–23 Jul)
low_tide_change_ctd <- function(ctd_variable_csv,
                                ctd_pressure_csv,
                                tides_tbl,
                                tz = "Pacific/Honolulu",
                                window_mins = 30,
                                min_lag_mins = 40,
                                max_lag_mins = 150,
                                match = c("lower_low", "all_lows"),
                                agg = c("mean", "min"),
                                pre_start   = as.Date("2014-07-06"),
                                pre_end     = as.Date("2014-07-19"),
                                storm_start = as.Date("2014-07-20"),
                                storm_end   = as.Date("2014-07-23"),
                                variable_name = NULL,
                                convert_to_cm = FALSE,
                                cm_per_unit = 100) {

  match <- match.arg(match)
  agg   <- match.arg(agg)

  low_noaa <- tides_tbl %>%
    filter(hilo == "L") %>%
    group_by(tide_date) %>%
    { if (match == "lower_low") slice_min(., verified_m, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) else . } %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      phase = case_when(
        tide_date >= pre_start   & tide_date <= pre_end   ~ "pre-storm",
        tide_date >= storm_start & tide_date <= storm_end ~ "storm",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(phase))

  p <- read_ctd(ctd_pressure_csv, tz = tz) %>% rename(pressure = value)

  lagged <- low_noaa %>%
    mutate(
      search_start = tide_datetime + minutes(min_lag_mins),
      search_end   = tide_datetime + minutes(max_lag_mins)
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      hfp_low_time = {
        x <- p %>% filter(datetime >= search_start, datetime <= search_end)
        if (nrow(x) == 0) as.POSIXct(NA) else {
          xmin <- min(x$pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
          min(x$datetime[x$pressure == xmin])
        }
      },
      lag_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(hfp_low_time, tide_datetime, units = "mins"))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(hfp_low_time))

  v <- read_ctd(ctd_variable_csv, tz = tz)

  if (is.null(variable_name)) {
    variable_name <- basename(ctd_variable_csv) %>%
      str_remove("\\.csv$") %>%
      str_remove("^extracted_") %>%
      str_remove("^ctd_extracted_")
  }

  matched <- lagged %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      low_tide_value = {
        t0 <- hfp_low_time
        x <- v %>%
          filter(datetime >= t0 - minutes(window_mins),
                 datetime <= t0 + minutes(window_mins)) %>%
          pull(value)
        if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_
        else if (agg == "mean") mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
        else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(low_tide_value))

  phase_means <- matched %>%
    group_by(phase) %>%
    summarize(
      variable      = variable_name,
      n_events      = n(),
      mean_low_tide = mean(low_tide_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_low_tide   = if (n() < 2) NA_real_ else sd(low_tide_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_lag_mins = mean(lag_minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  pre_mu   <- phase_means %>% filter(phase == "pre-storm") %>% pull(mean_low_tide)
  storm_mu <- phase_means %>% filter(phase == "storm")     %>% pull(mean_low_tide)

  list(
    matched_events = matched,
    phase_summary  = phase_means,
    comparison = tibble(
      variable                = variable_name,
      window_mins             = window_mins,
      lag_search_mins         = paste0(min_lag_mins, "–", max_lag_mins),
      pre_mean_low_tide       = pre_mu,
      storm_mean_low_tide     = storm_mu,
      delta                   = storm_mu - pre_mu,
      pct_higher_storm_vs_pre = (storm_mu / pre_mu - 1) * 100,
      delta_converted         = if (convert_to_cm) (storm_mu - pre_mu) * cm_per_unit else NA_real_,
      converted_units         = if (convert_to_cm) "cm" else NA_character_
    )
  )
}

# ---------- 7) RUN: pressure -------------------------------------------------
lowtide_pressure <- low_tide_change_ctd(
  ctd_variable_csv = file.path(input_path_2, "ctd_extracted_pressure.csv"),
  ctd_pressure_csv = file.path(input_path_2, "ctd_extracted_pressure.csv"),
  tides_tbl        = tides_tbl,
  match            = "lower_low",
  agg              = "mean",
  variable_name    = "pressure",
  convert_to_cm    = TRUE,
  cm_per_unit      = 100
)

# ---------- 8) RUN: salinity -------------------------------------------------
lowtide_salinity <- low_tide_change_ctd(
  ctd_variable_csv = file.path(input_path_2, "ctd_extracted_salinity.csv"),
  ctd_pressure_csv = file.path(input_path_2, "ctd_extracted_pressure.csv"),
  tides_tbl        = tides_tbl,
  match            = "lower_low",
  agg              = "mean",
  variable_name    = "salinity"
)

# Preview
rbind(lowtide_pressure$comparison,  lowtide_salinity$comparison)
rbind(lowtide_pressure$phase_summary, lowtide_salinity$phase_summary)
```
